entities.name: Anuradhapura Kingdom
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Kingdom of Anuradhapura, named for its capital city, was the second established kingdom of ancient Sri Lanka. According to the Mahāvaṃsa, it was founded by King Pandukabhaya in 437 BC, whose authority extended throughout the country.
